latestVersion.changelog:
Auto Caption Online 1.0.0 — initial release.

- Instantly generates subtitles for uploaded videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) using cloud GPU rendering.
- Supports video edits and exports at 1080p, returning captioned MP4 files in 30–60 seconds.
- Handles multilingual captions (e.g., English, Spanish) and batch processing in a session-based workflow.
- Simple onboarding with free credit token management; works out-of-the-box for new users.
- Clear error handling and onboarding instructions for session, token, and file support issues.
